name: PROSPECTUS_DIAGNOSIS_LQ178_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: PROSPECTUS_DIAGNOSIS_LQ178_20261107 — LQ-20261107-178, the prospectus writer's two failures.
The budget panel dropped CreditDenied's reason, so the page said 'the credit check was refused' while the
real cause was an unreadable credit journal (CREDIT_UNAVAILABLE). The panel now carries the reason code and
the page names the actual next step. A writer reply ended by the token cap was parsed, failed as
OUTPUT_NOT_JSON, retried three times identically and closed; finish_doc now names it OUTPUT_TRUNCATED.
Hermetic: no network, no DB; the credit book's snapshot is stubbed to raise.
